title: The Last Sigil Anew
author: Zephyrine Thackeray
blurb: Silas Oyelaran, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
